chunks: (Moses) said: "Do not hold me for having forgotten, and do not reprove me and make my task difficult."
ai.seo_question: What did Moses pray for regarding his forgetfulness and difficulties?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia tradition as a model for seeking divine ease during spiritual journeys, reflects Moses' (AS) humility in acknowledging human frailty before the Divine. It underscores the principle that God relieves the burden of those who strive, linking personal forgetfulness to broader themes of divine mercy and the alleviation of hardship in worship.
